column3: The exhortation is expressed once rather than twice.
The requests being made known becomes a direct command to present them.
The nouns excellence and praise become adjectives excellent and praiseworthy.
“Regardless of my circumstances” explains the situations he is in.
BSB’s “Christ” matches the Textus Receptus (Χριστῷ); the critical text does not name Him.
“Again and again” generalizes once and twice.
“May be credited” explains abounding to their account.
“All I need” specifies all things; the fullness is not separately expressed.
“Glorious riches” joins the riches with glory.
